summary: Ep 6 'Lost July' is an anime-original story (Elizabeth the plant technician, the masked assassin Kesskass, the sabotaged Inepril plant) built around two source slivers. Segment A = ch 4 'Popo' opening beats (the Nebraska bounty money, the sandsteamer's arrival, the town's party): a DUPLICATE — trigun.fandom's ch-4 page maps the chapter to episodes 5, 7 and 20 and NOT to ep 6, and our stored anchor ep 7 -> 6 [4] {4-6} already carries ch 4 in full (ep 7's own summary opens on the celebratory party and the steamer departure). Segment B = ch 0 'High Noon at July', a 6-page wordless prologue (the ruins of July, the date caption 02:06 7/21/0104, no corpses), used as Vash's flashback image inside Elizabeth's revenge plot; even at its maximum extent that is establishing imagery, not a story beat. Neither segment carries weight under T28's sliver clause, so the REMAINDER — a wholly anime-original episode — decides: ep 6 is FILLER, and the mixed override T6 (Sean 2026-08-25) is superseded for this row with evidence. No anchor (A1 for the retyped row; and a first-time sliver inside an original plot is A44 position-less in any case). Ep 16, the other T6 mixed row, is outside this ask and untouched.
